title: Having issues with leaking
text: Having issues with leaking. Maybe it's me or maybe it's the water bottles I have (Primo) but I am not impressed with this brand/style cap.  My water bottles sit on their side on a stand and after having used these for a short time they leak.  They made me nervous every time I used them because they just don't feel as secure as some of the other brands I've tried.  Maybe you'll have better luck with them but I would look towards one of the brands that seat more securely in the bottle neck.
